policy: Bundle data when redistribution is clearly licensed. Otherwise fetch public/freeware/shareware/demo data from the recorded upstream/public source and stage it locally without committing it to source control.

freeciv-data.source: data/ at the pinned source commit
freeciv-data.notes: Freeciv's data is distributed with its source under the GPL; nothing is downloaded. Individual tilesets and themes carry their own README credits, which must be reviewed (and kept) before a RELEASE package.
